demo.program:
# Trinidad and Tobago — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago?", "Port of Spain"),
    ("What currency does Trinidad and Tobago use?", "Dollar"),
    ("What is capital?", "Port of Spain"),
    ("What is currency?", "Dollar (TTD)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+1-868"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".tt"),
    ("What is driving side?", "left"),
    ("What is continent?", "North America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
